description: Omitting the bartack at the pocket corner leaves the junction between pocket opening and face cloth without any additional reinforcement stitch, producing the cleanest possible finish at the pocket mouth with no ornamental stitch visible to interrupt the cloth. This is appropriate on the most minimalist bespoke work where every surface detail has been considered and found unnecessary. In practice, fine bespoke construction relies on the strength of the underlying hand-stitching to secure pocket edges without a visible bartack.
forbidden: any pocket bartack rendered anywhere in frame — this option is its deliberate absence
